title: Your follow-up messages, for review
intro: These are the texts and emails your patients get from Boca Dental, word for word. Mark each one **Looks good**, or click **Change it** and type the wording you'd like. Your answers save as you go.
footer: Prepared for Boca Dental by Web Promotion Partners · November 2026 · You can come back to this page any time; your answers are saved.

msgs.subject: We Miss You!
msgs.text:
Hi [First name], I noticed you haven't been in to see us at Boca Dental for awhile.

I understand how busy life can be, but we want to make sure that your oral health is a priority. Regular dental visits help to prevent larger issues down the road!

Please reply to this email or text/call us with a good appointment time and we would be happy to confirm with you.

We look forward to seeing you!

[user.email_signature]

msgs.subject: Reaching Out About Your Appointment
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

I had reached out a few days ago because our records show you haven't been in to see us for a dental appointment in a while. I want to make sure that we get you on the schedule so that we can help keep your smile healthy & happy.

If you have concerns about insurance, cost, or anything else we would be happy to help - we offer a few great options to make dental care as affordable and as easy as possible.

Feel free to reply to this message or just give us a quick text or call and we can get you booked!

Thanks!

[user.email_signature]

msgs.subject: Can We Ask a Favor?
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

Can I ask your opinion on how your last appointment with us went?

It's been a long while since you've been in, and we would like to know if there is something we can do so that great patients like you keep coming back to see us for a lifetime of great oral health.

If scheduling a dental appointment with us has been at the back of your mind, great! I'd be more than happy to get you in to see us at a time that's convenient for you. Please give us a call or respond to this email and we'll get you confirmed!

Thank you!
